title: Audit seven-source search completeness and interruption
body:
## Summary

```text
PR3261: candidate representation
  -> this audit: branch partition, isolated children, checked witnesses
  -> false + timed_out is incomplete, not exhausted
  -> full 82-template caller/exhaustion coverage remains separate
```

Close PR3261's explicit `Engine::search` handoff with a scoped written proof and a separate literal-word Cartesian oracle. No source defect was found. Adds only `research/connector-search-exhaustion-audit/` and its bounded native workflow. No full B census, `f(7)=24` validation, supplier admission or new kappa.

Task `census-pruning-audit`, refined scope, priority revision 6. Base and refreshed canonical main are `463113d675af7410ac91d53a4fed51ec6494eb9a`. Contribution `b7b576c0fc8bf016d67af7f3fa6a4927bc2b1df8`. Both scientific inputs are canonical-main blobs; cold replay needs no unrelated pending PR object.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3261 leaves branching/exhaustion validation open after representation; PR3224 and PR3244 separately check capacity and propagation. **After:** actual native search agrees with all 914 Cartesian roots, including 50 branching satisfiable and 22 branching unsatisfiable cases. All 634 returned witnesses pass the literal-word oracle, and caller domains remain unchanged. The oracle evaluates 3,785,826 tuples.
- **Before:** a false search return alone is ambiguous. **After:** three real-deadline/checkpoint controls retain the interruption flag; positive and negative enumeration controls distinguish witnesses from exhaustion. Four compiled semantic mutants reject, including first-branch-only traversal and shared child domains.
- Registered CPython 3.12.15/GCC14 replay and six optimized source-boundary groups pass. Optimized CPython3.13.5/Clang19 matches every counter. GCC and Clang address/undefined-behavior builds report no diagnostics. Ruff, formatting and warnings-as-errors compilation pass.
- All eleven committed package/input bytes and export integrity pass. The exact committed, read-only export passes the full direct replay and source controls under optimized Python3.13 with Git absent from PATH. Hosted checks are separate and will be monitored on this exact head.

```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/connector-search-exhaustion-audit
```

README, SOURCES, RESULT and CHECKS contain the proof, environments, exact pins, controls and Open next questions. Next: audit full caller receipt acceptance and template/flag coverage before a separately budgeted independent B exhaustion. The external classification, non-simple branch, selected cold replay, physical supplier and full multiplication theorem remain unrun.

Credit conorholds for source/tables/fixtures, krzysztofwojt/PR3261 for the representation handoff, commdata2338/PR3224, Nick Petalas/PR3244, Nicholas Stone/PR2973, Aaron Wang, James Reed, Ross Richardson/PR943 and Douglas Colkitt/PR1185. Frozen inputs and predecessor notices are unchanged.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

One opt-in research package and bounded workflow. No shared verifier, frozen source or selected-frontier change. This is author-checked finite evidence and a scoped written proof, not independent human or proof-kernel review.
